verdict.rationale: Swell is a commerce platform, so a store-side agent-commerce endpoint is a fair question to ask. The evidence documents no MCP or UCP endpoint that lets shopping agents discover products or build carts. The AI-related material describes developer tooling: an agent that learns the app file contract and CLI, and a call that returns the store schema. Purchase links and the backend REST API are ordinary commerce APIs, not an agent-commerce protocol endpoint.
